fusions.name: Pocketed Move
fusions.desc: Slips you up to an enemy within 6 tiles, then deals 8 damage to it and silences it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

fusions.name: Lifted Purse
fusions.desc: Flicks a coin that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Gone in a Blink
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. Your movement speed rises 30% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Dead Act
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
